question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Profuse".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Scarce.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Profuse" means very plentiful or abundant in quantity. (प्रचुर)

◦ Example: The wound caused profuse bleeding that alarmed everyone in the emergency room.

 

• "Scarce" means insufficient in quantity; not enough to meet demand, and is therefore the correct antonym. (कमी)

◦ Example: After the drought, clean water became scarce across the entire region, causing severe hardship.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Abundant (प्रचुर): existing in large quantities — a synonym of profuse, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Copious (विपुल): abundant in supply or quantity — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Ample (पर्याप्त): enough or more than enough — close in sense to profuse.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of profuse: abundant, copious, plentiful, lavish, bountiful.

• Synonyms of scarce: rare, insufficient, sparse, meager, limited.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prosperity (समृद्धि): Poverty (गरीबी), Failure (असफलता)

2. Prudent (समझदार): Thoughtless (अविवेकी), Careless (लापरवाह)

3. Puissant (शक्तिशाली): Feeble (कमजोर), Weak (दुर्बल)

4. Pulchritude (सुंदरता): Ugliness (कुरूपता), Plainness (साधारणता)

5. Pulverize (चूर्ण करना): Restore (पुनः स्थापित करना), Repair (मरम्मत करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Nominal."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Significant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Nominal" means existing in name only; very small in amount or importance. (नाममात्र)

 

• "Significant" means sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention. It is therefore the correct antonym. (महत्वपूर्ण)

◦ Example: The new policy will have a significant impact on how small businesses report their annual taxes.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Trivial (तुच्छ) — of little value or importance; a synonym of nominal.

• Option 2: Minimal (न्यूनतम) — of the smallest possible amount; a synonym of nominal.

• Option 4: Token (सांकेतिक) — done as a symbolic gesture; a synonym of nominal.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of nominal: Substantial, Considerable, Real.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Purify (शुद्ध करना): Pollute (प्रदूषित करना), Contaminate (दूषित करना)

2. Purportedly (कथित रूप से): Impossibly (असंभव रूप से)

3. Pusillanimous (कायर): Brave (साहसी), Courageous (वीर)

4. Quaint (अनोखा / प्यारा): Ordinary (सामान्य), Common (साधारण)

5. Quell (दबाना): Provoke (भड़काना), Agitate (उत्तेजित करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Escalate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Reduce.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Escalate" means to increase rapidly in intensity, extent, or size. (बढ़ाना)

 

• "Reduce" means to make something smaller in size, amount, or degree. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कम करना)

◦ Example: The government introduced new policies to reduce traffic congestion in the city's crowded downtown area.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Aggravate (बदतर बनाना) — to make a problem worse; a synonym of escalate.

• Option 3: Intensify (तीव्र करना) — to make more intense; a synonym of escalate.

• Option 4: Amplify (बढ़ाना) — to increase strength or volume; a synonym of escalate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of escalate: Diminish, Decrease, Curtail.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quixotic (अव्यावहारिक): Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक), Realistic (यथार्थवादी)

2. Rampart (किले की दीवार): Ditch (खाई), Opening (खुला स्थान)

3. Random (अनियमित): Systematic (सुव्यवस्थित), Planned (योजनाबद्ध)

4. Ravaged (विनष्ट): Restored (पुनःस्थापित)

5. Rebarbative (अप्रिय / अरुचिकर): Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Ameliorate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Worsen.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ameliorate" means to make a bad or unsatisfactory situation better. (सुधारना)

◦ Example: New irrigation techniques helped ameliorate the effects of the prolonged drought on local farms.

 

• "Worsen" means to make or become worse, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बिगाड़ना)

◦ Example: The lack of proper medical care only served to worsen the villagers' health crisis.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Rectify (सुधारना): to correct or set right a fault — a synonym of ameliorate, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Enhance (बढ़ाना): to intensify or improve the quality of something — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Improve (सुधारना): to make or become better — close in sense to ameliorate.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of ameliorate: Improve, Enhance, Rectify, Upgrade, Better.

• Synonyms of worsen: Deteriorate, Aggravate, Degrade, Decline, Exacerbate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rebellion (विद्रोह): Loyalty (निष्ठा)

2. Recalcitrance (अवज्ञा): Compliance (आज्ञापालन), Obedience (आज्ञाकारिता)

3. Receive (प्राप्त करना): Give (देना), Send (भेजना)

4. Recount (बयान करना): Suppress (दबाना), Conceal (छिपाना)

5. Rectify (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Damage (हानि करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Innate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Learned.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Innate" means existing from birth; natural rather than acquired. (जन्मजात)

 

• "Learned" means acquired through study, experience, or training rather than being natural. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सीखा हुआ)

◦ Example: Empathy can be a learned behaviour, developed gradually through repeated social interaction and reflection.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Natural (प्राकृतिक) — existing in or caused by nature; a synonym of innate.

• Option 2: Inborn (जन्मजात) — present from birth; natural; a synonym of innate.

• Option 3: Instinctive (सहज) — done without conscious thought; a synonym of innate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of innate: Acquired, Cultivated, Trained.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Redeem (सुधारना): Forfeit (गंवाना), Ruin (बर्बाद करना)

2. Redolent (सुगंधित): Unscented (बिना गंध), Odorless (गंधहीन)

3. Refulgent (चमकदार): Dull (फीका), Dim (मंद)

4. Refuse (मना करना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Permit (अनुमति देना)

5. Relevant (प्रासंगिक): Inappropriate (अनुचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Exacerbate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Alleviate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Exacerbate" means to make a problem, situation, or feeling worse. (बिगाड़ना)

 

• "Alleviate" means to make suffering or a problem less severe. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कम करना)

◦ Example: Regular exercise and a balanced diet can significantly alleviate the symptoms associated with chronic stress.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Intensify (तीव्र करना) — to increase the strength of something; a synonym of exacerbate.

• Option 2: Worsen (बदतर करना) — to make something bad become worse; a synonym of exacerbate.

• Option 3: Aggravate (बिगाड़ना) — to make a problem more serious; a synonym of exacerbate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of exacerbate: Improve, Relieve, Ease.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Relinquish (त्यागना): Retain (रखना), Continue (जारी रखना)

2. Reluctant (अनिच्छुक): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Willing (तैयार)

3. Reprobate (अनैतिक व्यक्ति): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Moral (नैतिक)

4. Repudiate (त्यागना): Accept (स्वीकार करना), Approve (मंजूरी देना)

5. Repulsive (घृणित): Pleasant (सुखद)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Lax".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Strict.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Lax" means not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful. (लापरवाह)

◦ Example: Critics argued that lax enforcement of safety regulations contributed directly to the factory accident.

 

• "Strict" means demanding total obedience to rules or standards, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सख्त)

◦ Example: The new principal introduced strict rules about punctuality that surprised students accustomed to a relaxed schedule.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Careless (लापरवाह): not paying enough attention to detail — a synonym of lax, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Negligent (उपेक्षा करने वाला): failing to take proper care — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Slack (ढीला): not rigorous or careful enough — close in sense to lax.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of lax: Careless, Negligent, Slack, Loose, Casual.

• Synonyms of strict: Rigid, Stringent, Firm, Severe.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Resilient (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

2. Retired (सेवानिवृत्त): Active (सक्रिय), Working (कार्यरत)

3. Reverence (सम्मान): Contempt (तिरस्कार), Scorn (घृणा)

4. Risible (हंसने योग्य): Serious (गंभीर), Grave (गंभीर)

5. Rowdy (उपद्रवी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Calm (शांत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Refuse".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Accept.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Refuse" means to indicate unwillingness to do or accept something. (मना करना)

◦ Example: He decided to refuse the promotion because it required relocating his entire family abroad.

 

• "Accept" means to agree to receive or undertake something offered, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वीकार करना)

◦ Example: She was thrilled to accept the scholarship offer from the university she had always dreamed of.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Reject (नकारना): to dismiss as inadequate or unacceptable — a synonym of refuse, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Deny (इनकार करना): to state that something is not true — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Decline (अस्वीकार करना): to politely refuse to do something — close in sense to refuse.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of refuse: decline, reject, deny, rebuff, spurn.

• Synonyms of accept: agree, approve, receive, embrace, consent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ruthless (निर्दयी): Compassionate (दयालु), Kind (कृपालु)

2. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (अविवेकी)

3. Sanguine (आशावादी): Melancholic (निराश), Pessimistic (निराशावादी)

4. Scared (डरा हुआ): Brave (साहसी), Fearless (निर्भय)

5. Scary (डरावना): Comforting (सांत्वनादायक), Reassuring (आश्वस्त करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Intrinsic".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Extrinsic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Intrinsic" means belonging naturally to something; essential and inherent. (आंतरिक)

◦ Example: The intrinsic value of honesty is something parents try to instil in their children from an early age.

 

• "Extrinsic" means not part of the essential nature of something; coming from outside, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बाहरी)

◦ Example: Employees motivated mainly by extrinsic rewards such as bonuses often lose enthusiasm once incentives disappear.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Essential (आवश्यक): absolutely necessary or basic — a synonym of intrinsic, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Inherent (अंतर्निहित): existing as a natural part of something — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Innate (जन्मजात): existing from birth; natural — close in sense to intrinsic.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of intrinsic: Inherent, Innate, Essential, Fundamental, Basic.

• Synonyms of extrinsic: External, Extraneous, Outside, Peripheral.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Scattered (बिखरा): Gathered (इकट्ठा), Collected (संग्रहित)

2. Scrupulous (ईमानदार / नैतिक): Immoral (अनैतिक), Dishonest (बेईमान)

3. Searing (जलाना/तेज़ गर्म): Freezing (जमाने वाला/ठंडा), Cold (ठंडा)

4. Secure (सुरक्षित): Insecure (असुरक्षित), Unsafe (असुरक्षित)

5. Seldom (कभी-कभी): Frequently (अक्सर), Often (बार-बार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Unsure."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Certain.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Unsure" means not confident or certain about something. (अनिश्चित)

 

• "Certain" means having no doubt about something; completely confident. It is therefore the correct antonym. (निश्चित)

◦ Example: She was certain that she had locked the front door before leaving for work that morning.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Hesitant (झिझकने वाला) — slow to act because of feeling uncertain; a synonym of unsure.

• Option 2: Doubtful (संदेहास्पद) — uncertain or hesitant about something; a synonym of unsure.

• Option 3: Uncertain (अनिश्चित) — not able to be relied on; not definite; a synonym of unsure.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of unsure: Sure, Confident, Convinced.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Selective (चयनशील): Careless (लापरवाह), Indiscriminate (भेदभाव रहित)

2. Sell (बेचना): Buy (खरीदना), Purchase (खरीदना)

3. Serene (शांत): Chaotic (अशांत), Turbulent (उथल-पुथल)

4. Servile (चापलूस): Arrogant (घमंडी), Independent (स्वतंत्र)

5. Shallow (उथला): Deep (गहरा)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Euphemism".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Directness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Euphemism" means a mild or indirect word substituted for one considered harsh or blunt. (मंगलभाषी)

◦ Example: People often use a euphemism such as "passed away" instead of directly saying that someone has died.

 

• "Directness" means the quality of being straightforward and plain in expression, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सीधापन)

◦ Example: Her directness in giving feedback sometimes startled colleagues who were used to more diplomatic phrasing.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Understatement (अल्पोक्ति): a statement that softens or downplays something — a synonym of euphemism, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Indirection (अप्रत्यक्षता): the use of indirect methods of expression — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Circumlocution (घुमा-फिराकर कहना): an indirect way of expressing something — close in sense to euphemism.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of euphemism: Understatement, Circumlocution, Indirection, Softening, Mitigation.

• Synonyms of directness: Bluntness, Frankness, Candor, Forthrightness, Plainness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Shrink (सिकुड़ना): Expand (फैलना), Grow (बढ़ना)

2. Slander (बदनाम करना): Praise (प्रशंसा), Appreciate (सराहना)

3. Slender (पतला): Stout (मोटा), Thick (मोटा)

4. Sloppy (मैला/लापरवाह): Dashing (सजावटी/स्मार्ट), Neat (साफ-सुथरा)

5. Sluggish (सुस्त): Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Quaint".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Ordinary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Quaint" means attractively unusual or old-fashioned in a charming way. (अनोखा / प्यारा)

◦ Example: Tourists loved wandering through the quaint village with its cobblestone streets and centuries-old cottages.

 

• "Ordinary" means with no special or distinctive features; commonplace, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सामान्य)

◦ Example: The hotel room was fairly ordinary, with plain furniture and no notable view of the city.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Picturesque (सुरम्य): visually attractive, especially in a quaint way — a synonym of quaint, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Charming (आकर्षक): pleasant or attractive — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Old-fashioned (पुराने ढंग का): outdated in style or method — close in sense to quaint.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of quaint: charming, picturesque, old-fashioned, curious, whimsical.

• Synonyms of ordinary: common, normal, usual, typical, unremarkable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sneer (उपहास करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Respect (सम्मान करना)

2. Solicit (मदद माँगना): Prohibit (मना करना), Forbid (प्रतिबंध लगाना)

3. Somnolent (निद्रालु): Awake (जाग्रत), Alert (सतर्क)

4. Sophisticated (उन्नत): Primitive (आदिम), Simple (सरल)

5. Soporific (नींद लाने वाला): Stimulating (उत्तेजक), Energizing (ऊर्जावान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Jovial."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Morose.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Jovial" means cheerful and friendly in manner. (खुशमिजाज)

 

• "Morose" means sullen, gloomy, and ill-tempered in mood or manner. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदास)

◦ Example: He grew morose after losing his job and rarely spoke to anyone during the following weeks.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Cheerful (खुशमिजाज) — noticeably happy and optimistic; a synonym of jovial.

• Option 3: Jolly (प्रसन्न) — happy and cheerful in a lively way; a synonym of jovial.

• Option 4: Merry (हर्षित) — full of high-spirited happiness; a synonym of jovial.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of jovial: Gloomy, Sullen, Glum.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (अनियमित): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Spurious (नकली): Authentic (असली), Genuine (वास्तविक)

3. Squirm (घबराना/बेचैन होना): Relax (आराम करना), Calm (शांत रहना)

4. Stale (बासी): Fresh (ताज़ा), New (नया)

5. Staunch (दृढ़): Unsteady (अस्थिर), Weak (कमज़ोर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Celerity."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Slowness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Celerity" means swiftness of movement or action. (तेजी)

 

• "Slowness" means the quality of taking a long time to act or move. It is therefore the correct antonym. (धीमापन)

◦ Example: The slowness of the bureaucratic process frustrated applicants waiting months for their visas to be approved.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Speed (गति) — rate at which something moves; a synonym of celerity.

• Option 3: Rapidity (तीव्रता) — quickness of movement or action; a synonym of celerity.

• Option 4: Swiftness (तेज़ी) — quality of being fast; a synonym of celerity.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of celerity: Delay, Sluggishness, Lethargy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Strange (अजीब): Mundane (साधारण), Familiar (परिचित)

2. Strenuous (कठिन/जोरदार): Easy (आसान), Effortless (सरल)

3. Strong (मजबूत): Weak (कमजोर), Fragile (नाजुक)

4. Stunning (आश्चर्यजनक): Mundane (साधारण), Ordinary (सामान्य)

5. Sublime (उत्कृष्ट): Mediocre (साधारण), Inferior (निम्न)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Tacit".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Explicit.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Tacit" means understood or implied without being directly stated. (अव्यक्त)

◦ Example: There was a tacit agreement among the neighbors to keep the street quiet after ten.

 

• "Explicit" means stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for doubt, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्पष्ट)

◦ Example: The contract contained explicit terms outlining each party's responsibilities and obligations.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Implied (निहित): suggested without being directly stated — a synonym of tacit, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Implicit (अंतर्निहित): implied though not plainly expressed — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Unspoken (अनकहा): not stated aloud but understood — close in sense to tacit.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of tacit: Implicit, Unspoken, Implied, Understood, Unstated.

• Synonyms of explicit: Clear, Direct, Definite, Unambiguous, Specific.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Subterfuge (छल): Candor (स्पष्टवादिता), Honesty (ईमानदारी)

2. Success (सफलता): Failure (असफलता), Defeat (पराजय)

3. Superficial (सतही): Profound (गहरा), Deep (गंभीर)

4. Superfluous (अनावश्यक / फालतू): Essential (आवश्यक), Necessary (जरूरी)

5. Suppress (दबाना): Incite (उकसाना), Reveal (प्रकट करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Arraign."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Justify.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Arraign" means call or bring someone before a court to answer a charge. (आरोप लगाना)

 

• "Justify" means show or prove something to be right or reasonable. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सही ठहराना)

◦ Example: He tried to justify his absence from work by explaining the sudden family emergency he had faced.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Accuse (आरोप लगाना) — charge someone with an offense; a synonym of arraign.

• Option 2: Charge (अभियोग लगाना) — formally accuse someone of an offense; a synonym of arraign.

• Option 4: Indict (दोषारोपण करना) — formally accuse or charge with a crime; a synonym of arraign.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of arraign: Defend, Vindicate, Excuse.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Surreptitious (गुप्त): Overt (खुला), Open (स्पष्ट)

2. Sustainability (स्थिरता): Indefensibility (अस्थिरता/असुरक्षित स्थिति)

3. Sustenance (जीविका): Starvation (भूखमरी), Deprivation (वंचना)

4. Sweet (मीठा): Bitter (कड़वा), Sour (खट्टा)

5. Synthetic (कृत्रिम): Natural (प्राकृतिक), Genuine (वास्तविक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Mature."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Immature.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Mature" means fully developed physically, mentally, or emotionally. (परिपक्व)

 

• "Immature" means not fully developed; behaving in a childish or foolish way. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अपरिपक्व)

◦ Example: His immature reaction to criticism embarrassed the entire team during the client presentation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Developed (विकसित) — fully grown or advanced; a synonym of mature.

• Option 2: Adult (प्रौढ़) — having reached full development; a synonym of mature.

• Option 3: Grown-up (वयस्क) — fully developed into adulthood; a synonym of mature.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of mature: Childish, Juvenile, Undeveloped.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Taboo (वर्जित): Acceptable (स्वीकृत)

2. Tacit (अव्यक्त): Explicit (स्पष्ट), Expressed (प्रकट)

3. Taciturn (कम बोलने वाला): Talkative (बातूनी), Verbose (अधिक बोलने वाला)

4. Tangible (मूर्त): Intangible (अमूर्त), Abstract (अव्यक्त)

5. Tardy (सुस्त/देरी से): Prompt (समय पर), Quick (तेज)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Egalitarian".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Biased.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Egalitarian" means believing in or based on the principle that all people are equal. (समानतावादी)

◦ Example: The new constitution promoted an egalitarian society where every citizen enjoyed equal rights.

 

• "Biased" means showing unfair prejudice for or against someone or something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (पक्षपाती)

◦ Example: The judge was accused of being biased after consistently favoring one party in his rulings.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Fair (निष्पक्ष): treating people equally without favoritism — a synonym of egalitarian, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Just (न्यायपूर्ण): based on what is morally right — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Equitable (न्यायसंगत): fair and impartial — close in sense to egalitarian.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of egalitarian: Equitable, Fair, Impartial, Just, Nondiscriminatory.

• Synonyms of biased: Prejudiced, Partial, Discriminatory, Unfair, One-sided.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tedious (उबाऊ / थकाऊ): Exciting (रोचक), Engaging (आकर्षक)

2. Tenacious (जिद्दी / दृढ़): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Tenebrous (अंधकारमय): Bright (उज्ज्वल), Clear (स्पष्ट)

4. Thwart (विफल करना): Assist (सहायता करना), Help (मदद करना)

5. Timid (डरपोक): Daring (साहसी), Bold (निडर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Altercation."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Compromise.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Altercation" means a noisy, heated argument or public dispute. (विवाद)

 

• "Compromise" means a settlement of differences in which each side makes concessions. It is therefore the correct antonym. (समझौता)

◦ Example: After hours of negotiation, both parties finally reached a compromise on the wage dispute.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Dispute (विवाद) — a disagreement or argument; a synonym of altercation.

• Option 3: Squabble (तकरार) — a petty, noisy quarrel; a synonym of altercation.

• Option 4: Quarrel (झगड़ा) — an angry argument between people; a synonym of altercation.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of altercation: Agreement, Accord.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Torpor (सुस्ती): Liveliness (सजीवता), Activity (सक्रियता)

2. Traditional (परम्परागत): Modern (आधुनिक), Unusual (असामान्य)

3. Traitor (देशद्रोही): Loyal (वफादार), Patriot (देशभक्त)

4. Transient (क्षणिक): Permanent (स्थायी), Lasting (दीर्घकालिक)

5. Transitory (अस्थायी): Eternal (स्थायी), Permanent (स्थायी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Appreciate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Depreciate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Appreciate" means recognize the full worth or value of something. (सराहना करना)

 

• "Depreciate" means diminish in value over time, or belittle something. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मूल्य घटाना)

◦ Example: The value of the old machinery will depreciate rapidly once newer, more efficient models enter the market.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Treasure (संजोना) — value something highly and keep it safe; a synonym of appreciate.

• Option 3: Value (महत्व देना) — consider something to be important or worthwhile; a synonym of appreciate.

• Option 4: Cherish (प्रिय मानना) — protect and care for something lovingly; a synonym of appreciate.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of appreciate: Criticize, Disparage, Undervalue.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Trepidation (घबराहट): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (आरामदायक)

2. Triumph (विजय): Defeat (पराजय), Failure (असफलता)

3. Triumphant (विजयी): Defeated (पराजित), Unsuccessful (असफल)

4. Trivial (तुच्छ): Important (महत्वपूर्ण), Significant (जरूरी)

5. Truculent (लड़ाकू): Amiable (मिलनसार), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Ignorance".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Knowledge.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ignorance" means lack of knowledge or information about something. (अज्ञान)

◦ Example: His ignorance of local customs led to several embarrassing misunderstandings during his first week abroad.

 

• "Knowledge" means facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education, and is therefore the correct antonym. (ज्ञान)

◦ Example: Her deep knowledge of ancient history impressed even the most experienced archaeologists on the team.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Illiteracy (निरक्षरता): inability to read or write; lack of education — a synonym of ignorance, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Naivety (भोलापन): lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Unawareness (अनभिज्ञता): lack of awareness or knowledge — close in sense to ignorance.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of ignorance: unawareness, illiteracy, naivety, inexperience, unfamiliarity.

• Synonyms of knowledge: awareness, understanding, wisdom, erudition, learning.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tumult (शोर-शराबा): Calmness (शांति), Silence (मौन)

2. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (सुकून भरा)

3. Turpitude (अनैतिकता): Morality (नैतिकता), Virtue (सदाचार)

4. Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक): Comfortable (आरामदायक), Easy (सहज)

5. Undesirable (अवांछनीय): Advisable (उचित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Immigration."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Emigration.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Immigration" means the act of coming to live permanently in a foreign country. (आप्रवासन)

 

• "Emigration" means the act of leaving one's own country to settle permanently in another. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रवासन)

◦ Example: Widespread emigration from the war-torn region left many villages nearly empty within a few years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Resettlement (पुनर्वास) — the action of settling in a new place; a synonym of immigration.

• Option 2: Settlement (बसावट) — the process of settling in a new place; a synonym of immigration.

• Option 3: Migration (प्रवासन) — movement of people to settle elsewhere; a synonym of immigration.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of immigration: Exit, Exodus, Departure.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Unprecedented (अभूतपूर्व): Familiar (परिचित)

2. Unsure (अनिश्चित): Certain (निश्चित), Sure (पक्का)

3. Upright (ईमानदार): Corrupt (भ्रष्ट), Dishonest (बेईमान)

4. Usurp (हड़पना): Restore (वापस करना), Surrender (समर्पण करना)

5. Utterly (पूरी तरह): Minimally (न्यूनतम), Slightly (थोड़ा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Traitor."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Loyal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Traitor" means a person who betrays their country, cause, or friend. (देशद्रोही)

 

• "Loyal" means giving firm and constant support to a person or cause. It is therefore the correct antonym. (वफादार)

◦ Example: Even during the company's toughest year, the loyal employees never once considered leaving for a rival firm.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Betrayer (विश्वासघाती) — one who betrays trust or loyalty; a synonym of traitor.

• Option 2: Turncoat (दलबदलू) — a person who deserts one's cause for another; a synonym of traitor.

• Option 4: Defector (पक्षत्यागी) — one who abandons their country or party; a synonym of traitor.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of traitor: Patriot, Faithful, Devoted.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vacillate (डगमगाना): Decide (निर्णय लेना), Resolve (निश्चित करना)

2. Vain (घमंडी/अहंकारी): Humble (नम्र), Modest (विनम्र)

3. Vehement (तीव्र/जोरदार): Mild (मंद), Gentle (कोमल)

4. Venerable (आदरणीय): Immature (अपरिपक्व), Disrespectful (अनादरपूर्ण)

5. Venerate (सम्मान करना): Despise (घृणा करना), Disrespect (अनादर करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Upright."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Corrupt.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Upright" means strictly honest or morally correct; adhering to moral standards. (ईमानदार)

 

• "Corrupt" means willing to act dishonestly in exchange for money or personal gain. It is therefore the correct antonym. (भ्रष्ट)

◦ Example: The investigation revealed that several corrupt officials had been accepting bribes for years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Righteous (धर्मी) — morally right or justifiable; a synonym of upright.

• Option 2: Virtuous (सदाचारी) — having or showing high moral standards; a synonym of upright.

• Option 3: Honest (ईमानदार) — free of deceit; truthful and sincere; a synonym of upright.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of upright: Dishonest, Crooked, Unscrupulous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Venom (जहर): Benevolent (दयालुता), Antidote (विषनाशक)

2. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Dishonesty (बेईमानी)

3. Veracity (सत्यता): Falsehood (असत्य), Lie (झूठ)

4. Veteran (अनुभवी): Novice (नवसिखुआ), Beginner (शुरुआती)

5. Vexatious (कष्टदायक / तंग करने वाला): Pleasant (सुखद), Comforting (आरामदायक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Munificent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Stingy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Munificent" means extremely generous, especially in giving money or gifts. (उदार)

 

• "Stingy" means unwilling to give or spend money; miserly. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कंजूस)

◦ Example: His stingy uncle refused to tip even the most attentive waiters at family dinners.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Generous (उदार) — willing to give freely; a synonym of munificent.

• Option 3: Charitable (दानशील) — generous toward those in need; a synonym of munificent.

• Option 4: Bountiful (प्रचुर) — giving generously and plentifully; a synonym of munificent.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of munificent: Miserly, Frugal, Parsimonious.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Negligent (लापरवाह)

2. Vilify (बदनाम करना): Commend (प्रशंसा करना), Praise (सराहना)

3. Vindicate (निर्दोष साबित करना): Accuse (आरोप लगाना), Blame (दोष देना)

4. Violent (हिंसक): Gentle (कोमल), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

5. Vivacious (चंचल): Dull (नीरस), Lifeless (निष्प्राण)
